description: Cancels one of your own renders and deletes its files (DELETE /mastering/jobs/{id}). The render quota already consumed is refunded when the render was not finished. Needs the mastering:write scope. Only call it when the user asked to stop that render. An unknown id, or a render of another account, answers 404.
name: jj_mastering_cancel_job
title: Cancel a Mastering render
